name: io.github.runhooks/runhooks-mcp
description: Schedule and manage cron jobs and webhooks on Runhooks from your AI agent.

environmentVariables.name: RUNHOOKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Runhooks API key (rh_live_...). Required for all tools except provision_account; get one instantly with the provision_account tool, the dashboard, or the CLI.

environmentVariables.name: RUNHOOKS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin override. Defaults to https://api.runhooks.app.
